skills.name: Subtract like-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and retaining the denominator.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractions and rewrite the fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Manage whole-number parts
skills.definition: Separate mixed or whole-number operands into whole and fractional parts, subtract whole-number parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Reduce fractional results to lowest terms or normalize a zero fractional part to an integer.

skills.name: Convert unlike denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator, typically the LCD, and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities with the same denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator, including cases with zero or improper intermediate numerators.

skills.name: Handle mixed and whole parts
skills.definition: Decompose mixed numbers or whole numbers into whole and fractional parts, subtract whole-number parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as denominator-over-denominator fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.

skills.name: Subtract aligned pure fractions
skills.definition: Subtract two pure fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and interpreting zero results when they occur.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike denominators and convert the relevant fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract mixed or whole numbers without regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed-number or whole-number quantities by separating whole and fractional parts, subtracting aligned parts when the fractional subtraction is nonnegative, and recombining the result.

skills.name: Subtract mixed or whole numbers with regrouping
skills.definition: Subtract mixed-number or whole-number quantities when the fractional part would be negative by borrowing one or more wholes, converting each borrowed whole into denominator-over-denominator form, and recombining the result.

skills.name: Reduce fractional result
skills.definition: Simplify a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.

skills.name: Subtract pure fractions with common denominators
skills.definition: Subtract numerator values and keep the common denominator in a pure-fraction subtraction expression once denominators match.

skills.name: Find common denominators and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find an LCD or suitable common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions or fractional parts as equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract mixed or whole numbers without regrouping
skills.definition: Separate or rewrite operands into whole and fractional parts, subtract whole and common-denominator fractional parts when the fractional difference is nonnegative, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Regroup in mixed or whole number subtraction
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction would be negative, borrow or regroup one or more whole units into denominator-sized fractional units before subtracting and recombining.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result or fractional part to lowest terms.

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find an appropriate common denominator for unlike denominators and convert fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fraction numerators over a common denominator, keep the denominator, and reduce or clean up the fractional result when needed.

skills.name: Coordinate whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Separate, subtract, carry, and recombine whole-number and fractional parts when working with mixed numbers or whole-number operands.

skills.name: Borrow across a mixed number
skills.definition: Regroup one or more wholes as denominator-over-denominator fractions when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.
